cohort_plan.seed_policy: seed = base_seed + sample_index; scheduler.generator=None per request
cohort_plan.source_order: Frozen enumeration of the original canonical twenty rows; original native_source_ordinal retained separately; no new source sampling.

storage_accounting.global_job_directory_views: forty relative directory symlinks inside the same output root, pointing into partN/sourceXX_seed42/mode; no copied videos or alias samples

quality_protocol.core_metrics: Every generated clip: tools/ffnds_video_metrics.py over all81 actual frames; candidate references its newly paired Dense. Core diagnostics are CPU-only and official learned scoring remains separate.
quality_protocol.sampling_mode: CUSTOM_PAIRED: twenty unique image-prompt clusters, one true seed42 generation per arm per source; 160 FFN positions and video frames remain nested observations.
quality_protocol.planned_aggregation: Paired per-source changes and source/image-cluster uncertainty using ffnds_cluster_metric_report.py after independent learned scoring; development cohort, no population-blind confirmation claim.
quality_protocol.human_fullplay_review: PENDING; static frame inspection cannot replace full-play acceptance.
quality_protocol.motion_interpretation: Low flow and static scenes are diagnostics; preserve prompt and appearance-motion interpretation.

cost_denominator: Complete40blocks×4steps. Full FFN boundary timer includes native modulation and gated residual. Generation wall includes original-dtype initial-noise observation/save/hash/byte-comparison, four FP32 post-state saves/hashes, and native video save. Shared CPU/model setup is once per part, exclusive weight preload separately per video. One technical generation per mode; no inherited speed claim.
neutrality_precondition: Exact original neutral replay succeeded for formal20 inputs00 and10 using this identical hook: all four scheduler latent rawSHAs plus complete video bytes. Those two exact controls are immutable prerequisites; no twenty-source neutral reruns are claimed.
